title: Doc comments say 'rocksdb' and 'webdav' but actual TOML keys are 'rocks_db' and 'web_dav'
description: crates/core/src/ipfs_backend.rs line 34 says Required when type = "webdav" but serde rename_all = snake_case on BackendType maps WebDav to web_dav. Line 46 says type = "rocksdb" but RocksDb maps to rocks_db. A user reading the struct docs would write the wrong TOML key and get a confusing parse error. Fix: update both doc strings to use the actual TOML strings web_dav and rocks_db respectively.
